verdicts.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include any injection or invasive modality. For purposes of this section invasive modality means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or other means. Invasive modality includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.
verdicts.reasoning: The statute explicitly states that lasers are an invasive modality and are excluded from optometric practice. Therefore, no laser procedures are authorized — the answer is present in the text and was missed.

verdicts.quote: The commissioner shall issue appropriate certificates to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in accordance with the provisions of this section... for additional authorization for the purpose of utilizing diagnostic pharmaceutical agents, a fee of sixty dollars, and for certification to use or prescribe oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, a fee of two hundred fifty dollars.
verdicts.reasoning: The statute establishes a tiered certification system: basic optometrist license, certification for diagnostic pharmaceuticals, certification for topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, certification for glaucoma/ocular hypertension therapeutic agents, and certification for oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents. These are named tiers with different authorities and fees present in the text.
